description: Send an SMS to many recipients at once. Body supports {{var}} placeholders that are filled per-recipient when you pass {phone, vars} objects (e.g. recipients=[{phone:"0912...", vars:{first_name:"小美"}}]). For uniform messages, plain phone strings work too. Optional scheduled_at delays send.

body.description: Message template. Use {{key}} placeholders to interpolate per-recipient vars; missing keys are kept literal.

recipients.description: Either an array of phone strings, OR an array of {phone, vars} objects for personalisation.

vars.description: Per-recipient values for {{var}} placeholders in body.

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601 with timezone; omit for immediate send.

name: send_broadcast
